profile.model: Thrive is a generalist internet and software investor with no separate bio fund. It makes large, concentrated bets on AI-native biology and healthcare, framed around 'bilingual' companies that combine medicine and technology. It leads big rounds in frontier AI drug design (Isomorphic Labs, Chai Discovery seed) and joins later rounds in longevity, neurotech and clinical AI.
profile.summary: Thrive has become one of the largest single sources of capital for AI drug discovery, leading Isomorphic Labs' $600M first external round in 2025 and its $2.1B round in 2026. Its health portfolio otherwise skews toward healthcare services and clinical AI, starting with Oscar Health, its first investment.
